description: A four-panel composite of Kernel Average Misorientation (KAM) EBSD maps, all rendered with the same "Unique color map" rainbow legend (blue → green → red) whose inset in every panel is labelled "Min 0" and "Max 5" (the caption/citation treat these as misorientation in degrees), each panel carrying a 60 um scale bar and its average KAM value printed top-right. (a) MAF-0, KAM_avg = 0.34°: almost uniformly dark blue, a few large grains separated by thin dark boundaries and sparse small dark non-indexed spots. (b) MAF-1, KAM_avg = 0.72°: blue matrix with green patches and streaks, isolated red elongated features, dark boundary networks. (c) MAF-3, KAM_avg = 0.87°: dense interpenetrating green/blue network crossed by strong dark bands. (d) MAF-5, KAM_avg = 1.07°: red- and dark-red-dominated with residual green and only isolated blue regions. The group makes one argument: local misorientation (stored strain) rises monotonically with the number of multiaxial forging passes, from essentially strain-free solution-annealed MAF-0 to the most heavily deformed MAF-5. No numeric values other than the four printed KAM averages and the 0/5 legend ends appear on the panels.

subfigures.description: KAM map of MAF-0 (0 pass) with printed KAM_avg = 0.34°. Uniformly dark blue (low misorientation) with a few large grains delimited by thin dark boundaries and a handful of small dark spots; 60 um scale bar and Min 0/Max 5 rainbow legend at the bottom.

KAM map of MAF-1 (one forging pass) with printed KAM_avg = 0.72°. Blue background plus scattered green patches/streaks and a few red elongated features along dark boundary traces; 60 um scale bar and Min 0/Max 5 legend.
KAM map of MAF-3 (three passes) with printed KAM_avg = 0.87°. Dense interpenetrating network of green and blue with prominent dark bands crossing the field; 60 um scale bar and Min 0/Max 5 legend.

KAM map of MAF-5 (five passes) with printed KAM_avg = 1.07°. Field dominated by red and dark red with subordinate green and only isolated blue regions, i.e. the highest local misorientation of the series; 60 um scale bar and Min 0/Max 5 legend.

observations.observation: Panel (a) for MAF-0 prints an average KAM value of 0.34° and is visually dominated by dark blue, consistent with very low local misorientation.
Panel (b) for MAF-1 prints an average KAM value of 0.72°.
Panel (c) for MAF-3 prints an average KAM value of 0.87°.
Panel (d) for MAF-5 prints an average KAM value of 1.07°, the highest of the four panels.
All four panels carry the same 60 um scale bar and the same rainbow colour legend labelled 'Min 0' and 'Max 5'.
The fraction of the mapped area coloured green and red increases monotonically from panel (a) to panel (d), i.e. with the number of multiaxial forging passes.
Panel (b) contains a few discrete red elongated features (highest local misorientation) not present in the largely uniform blue field of panel (a).
The caption states the figure shows KAM maps (Unique color map) for (a) MAF-0, (b) MAF-1, (c) MAF-3 and (d) MAF-5.

The citing text states that the MAF-0 material reports an average KAM value of 0.34°, indicating minimal plastic deformation persisting even after solution annealing, with blue representing low strain.

The citing text states the KAM value rises to 0.72° after a single forging pass, 0.87° after three passes (with uniformity of misorientation attributed to tri-axial deformation) and 1.07° after five passes, indicating progressively greater plastic deformation.
The citing text states that the accumulation of dislocations with increasing strain is further supported by the KAM map of this figure.
Dark near-black bands and traces are visible in panels (b)-(d) but their nature (grain boundaries versus non-indexed/low-confidence regions) cannot be determined from the pixels.

measured_quantities: local misorientation colour scale, Min 0 – Max 5 (°, unit not printed on the image)
unreadable_items: The unit of the colour legend 'Min 0 / Max 5' is not printed on any panel; degrees are inferred only from the degree symbol on the KAM_avg labels
The identity of the dark near-black bands and boundary traces in panels (b)-(d) (grain boundaries vs non-indexed regions) is not resolvable at the supplied resolution
No pixel-level KAM distribution/statistics (only the single average value) are shown, so per-region values cannot be read
